title: Practice 5: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Индустриализацию региона нужно ___ (проводить / провести, inf.) очень осторожно, во избежание разрушения окружающей среды.
exercises.why: **проводить** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: провести).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
exercises.prompt: Industrialization of the region must be carried out very carefully to avoid environmental destruction.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (пройти — to pass, to go, to walk; pf., past pl.) мимо.
exercises.why: **прошли** — past tense (plural) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
